title: Seal the recovery device
responsibility: Seal the recovery device's private keys under the recovery secret and open them again as non-extractable keys.

inputs.name: sealedRecovery.secret
inputs.description: Recovery secret used to encrypt the recovery device's private keys.

inputs.name: sealedRecovery.device
inputs.description: Recovery device identity and extractable private keys.

inputs.name: openSealedRecovery.secret
inputs.description: Recovery secret used when the blob was created.

inputs.name: openSealedRecovery.blob
inputs.description: Encrypted recovery blob to authenticate and open.

outputs.name: sealedRecovery
outputs.description: Encrypted recovery device payload and the metadata needed to open it.

outputs.name: openSealedRecovery
outputs.description: Recovered device identity with private keys imported as non-extractable.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The secret length is invalid, the recovery keys are unavailable for export, or the secret cannot authenticate the blob.
